title: Ronnie Pays It Forward
description: Ronnie answers your money-and-debt letters with serene confidence and zero financial literacy. One running fix for everything: open another card. Barry can read a bank statement. Barry loses.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome back to Pay It Forward, where your debt is just a feeling. Barry, first letter.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Donna's got nine thousand on a card and can barely make the minimum.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Donna, sweetheart, the minimum is the bank politely telling you that's all they want. You're square.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That is... that is not how interest works, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So open a second card, Barry. Pay the first one off with it. <p:0.3> Debt's gone, Donna. Poof.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Next one. Marcus is a new dad. He wants an emergency fund, but there's nothing left to save.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Easy. Spend the emergency money before the emergency. Then the emergency can't take it from you.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Marcus, do not. Ronnie, that's the opposite of a fund.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So get a third card, Barry. Label it the emergency card. <p:0.3> The card IS the fund.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Quick update. Donna wrote back. She took your advice. <p:0.3> She now has six cards. She's calling it a portfolio.
